question: What is Pass Pro?
answer: Pass Pro is our premium subscription that gives you unlimited access to all mock tests, live classes, and premium study materials for a full year.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: If you have forgotten your password, go to the login screen and click 'Forgot Password'. A reset link will be sent to your registered email address.

question: Are the live classes recorded?
answer: Yes! All our live classes are recorded and automatically uploaded to your student dashboard within 24 hours so you can review them at any time.

question: What is the refund policy?
answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, contact support within 7 days of payment for a full refund.

question: How are the Leaderboard scores calculated?
answer: Leaderboard scores are based on your performance in the weekly Mega Mock Tests. Speed and accuracy both contribute to your final ranking.
